text: {"verdict": "supported", "answer": "The evidence shows that Rpl38 mutant mouse embryos have unchanged global protein synthesis while the translation of a select subset of Homeobox (Hox) mRNAs is perturbed, with RPL38 facilitating 80S complex formation on these transcripts to confer transcript-specific translational control.
